ei.title: The Old Man and the Qualified Temple Manager
ei.subject: 9월_2023 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Old Man and the Qualified Temple Manager

fullPassage: Long ago, an old man built a grand temple at the center of his village. People traveled to worship at the temple. So the old man made arrangements for food and accommodation inside the temple itself. He needed someone who could look after the temple, so he put up a notice: Manager needed. Seeing the notice, many people went to the old man. But he returned all the applicants after interviews, telling them, "I need a qualified person for this work." The old man would sit on the roof of his house every morning, watching people go through the temple doors. One day, he saw a young man come to the temple. When that young man left the temple, the old man called him and asked, "Will you take care of this temple?" The young man was surprised by the offer and replied, "I have no experience caring for a temple. I'm not even educated." The old man smiled and said, "I don't want any educated man. I want a qualified person." Confused, the young man asked, "But why do you consider me a qualified person?" The old man replied, "I buried a brick on the path to the temple. I watched for many days as people tripped over that brick. No one thought to remove it. But you dug up that brick." The young man said, "I haven't done anything great. It's the duty of every human being to think about others. I only did my duty." The old man smiled and said, "Only people who know their duty and perform it are qualified people."

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) built=지었다, (B) surprised=놀란, (C) buried=묻었다
det.analysis:
✅ ① built — surprised — buried: 원문 일치. 노인이 사원을 '지었고(built)', 청년은 제안에 '놀랐으며(surprised)', 노인이 벽돌을 '묻었다(buried)'는 흐름에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② destroyed — surprised — buried: (A) destroyed(파괴했다)는 사원을 지었다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ built — bored — buried: (B) bored(지루한)는 뜻밖의 제안에 놀란 반응과 어울리지 않음
❌ ④ built — surprised — revealed: (C) revealed(드러냈다)는 벽돌을 '묻었다'는 원문과 반대
det.tip: built a grand temple / was surprised by the offer / I buried a brick

❌ ③ ordinary: ordinary(평범한)는 웅장함과 반대되는 의미
❌ ④ ancient: ancient(고대의)는 시간에 관한 것으로 규모·웅장함과 의미축이 다름
det.tip: a grand temple = a magnificent temple — 웅장한

questions.passage: Long ago, an old man built a grand temple at the center of his village. People traveled to worship at the temple. So the old man made <u>arrangements</u> for food and accommodation inside the temple itself. He needed someone who could look after the temple, so he put up a notice: Manager needed. Seeing the notice, many people went to the old man. But he returned all the applicants after interviews, telling them, "I need a qualified person for this work." The old man would sit on the roof of his house every morning, watching people go through the temple doors. One day, he saw a young man come to the temple. When that young man left the temple, the old man called him and asked, "Will you take care of this temple?" The young man was surprised by the offer and replied, "I have no experience caring for a temple. I'm not even educated." The old man smiled and said, "I don't want any educated man. I want a qualified person." Confused, the young man asked, "But why do you consider me a qualified person?" The old man replied, "I buried a brick on the path to the temple. I watched for many days as people tripped over that brick. No one thought to remove it. But you dug up that brick." The young man said, "I haven't done anything great. It's the duty of every human being to think about others. I only did my duty." The old man smiled and said, "Only people who know their duty and perform it are qualified people."

questions.passage:

(B) At the airport, travelers must pay a <u>duty</u> on the expensive watches they bought abroad.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 duty의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: duty: (A) 의무 (학생이 마땅히 해야 할 일) / (B) 관세·세금 (수입 물품에 부과되는 세금)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 의무 — (B) 의무: (B)의 duty는 공항에서 물품에 내는 '관세'이지 의무가 아님
❌ ② (A) 권리 — (B) 관세: (A)는 마땅히 해야 하는 '의무'이지 '권리'가 아님
✅ ③ (A) 의무 — (B) 관세(세금): (A)는 학생의 '의무', (B)는 수입품에 부과되는 '관세'로 문맥에 맞음 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 직업 — (B) 의무: (A)에 '직업'의 뜻은 없고, (B)도 '의무'가 아니라 관세
det.tip: duty: ① 의무 ② (수입품) 관세 — 본문 the duty of every human being은 ① 의무

❌ ③ customer: customer(고객)는 물건·서비스를 사는 사람으로 정의와 무관
✅ ④ applicant: applicant(지원자)는 '일자리·자리를 정식으로 신청하는 사람'이라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답

det.korean: 청년은 대단한 일을 한 게 아니라 남을 배려하는 것이 모두의 의무라고 말함. 즉 '남을 생각하는(think about others)' 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore the mistakes of others: '남의 실수를 무시한다'는 것은 배려의 의무와 관련이 없음

❌ ③ seek rewards for good deeds: 청년은 대가를 바라지 않고 의무만 다했다고 했으므로 '선행의 대가를 구한다'는 것과 모순
❌ ④ avoid difficult tasks: '어려운 일을 피한다'는 것은 의무를 다한다는 태도와 반대
det.tip: It's the duty of every human being to think about others — 남을 생각하다
